statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-87862: when curl loads an HSTS cache file in which an includeSubDomains entry for a parent domain comes before a longer-lived entry for one of its subdomains, it silently drops the subdomain entry, so once the parent entry expires curl can send plain HTTP requests to a host whose HSTS policy is still valid (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-87862.html). It affects the curl tool and libcurl from 8.11.0 to 8.22.0 and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/a1614c3bcf1593eb524b37792124357d97a5429c, which makes the load path skip only an exact duplicate of the host, by passing FALSE instead of the entry's includeSubDomains flag to the HSTS lookup in lib/hsts.c. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 published in the DHI Alpine main repository as of 2026-11-28 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. In the HSTS object of the static libcurl.a in curl-static and in libcurl.so.4 in libcurl (located with the symbols in curl-dbg), on x86_64 and aarch64, the function that adds entries while loading the cache file passes the entry's includeSubDomains flag from a register as that lookup argument in every build before 8.23.0-r0, and a constant zero in 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1. 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build. Packages published only in the DHI Alpine security repository, which needs credentials, were not inspected.
